# XTRONIC KIDS

> XTRONIC KIDS makes hands-on STEM robotics and solar engineering kits for kids aged 6 and up. Kits are screen-free, snap-together builds that teach real mechanics, circuits and solar power, shipped across Australia and Sri Lanka.

XTRONIC KIDS is the kids' STEM kit line from XTRONIC, a hands-on electronics and robotics project running since 2018 (previously Digicocoon, then Ravana PCB).

## Products

- [Shop all STEM kits](/shop): the full catalog of solar, robotics and wooden-mechanics kits for kids 6+.
- [Solar 4-Wheel Drive DIY Rover](/shop/solar-4wd-rover): a battery-free solar-powered off-road car kit.
- [Wooden Taxiing Aircraft Kit](/shop/wooden-taxiing-aircraft): a laser-cut wooden plane with a working propeller circuit.
- [Solar-Powered Yacht / Speedboat](/shop/solar-speedboat): a waterproof solar boat kit.
- [Smart Voice-Controlled Robot Kit](/shop/voice-robot): a robot that responds to claps and voice triggers.
- [Solar-Powered Flapping Butterfly](/shop/solar-butterfly): a solar mechanism kit with a wing-flutter linkage.
- [5-in-1 STEM Kit Bundle](/shop/stem-bundle-5in1): all five kits at a bundle discount.
